name: Baidu Apollo Go
sub: Robotaxi & passenger L4; Robotaxi consumer services; Purpose-built robotaxi/pod makers
regions: China; Gulf and international expansion announced
founded: 2013 Apollo program; Apollo Go service later
leadership: Robin Li, co-founder and CEO of Baidu; Wang Yunpeng, corporate vice president and president of the Intelligent Driving Group
about: Baidu's robotaxi service is the largest Chinese deployment anchor, centered on Wuhan and other Chinese cities, with international partnerships forming in the Gulf and Europe.
model: Robotaxi fares; autonomous driving technology ecosystem; platform partnerships
deployment: Beijing, Wuhan, Chongqing, Shenzhen and other Chinese cities; fully driverless commercial service in Dubai launched March 2026 with Dubai Taxi Company and Uber; Abu Dhabi scaling; South Korea entry announced; UK, Germany and Switzerland flagged for 2026 entry.
metrics: 22M+ cumulative public rides across 27 cities and 330M+ autonomous km (220M+ fully driverless) as of April 2026; weekly rides around 350,000 in Q1 2026. Wuhan operations suspended after the 31 March 2026 fleet-wide outage; China froze new AV permits nationwide on 29 April and was reported to be resuming them gradually on 23 July 2026.
signal: China's permit freeze after the Wuhan outage was reported lifting on 23 July 2026 (Bloomberg, unconfirmed); international launches continued in Seoul, Switzerland (AmiGo with PostBus) and Abu Dhabi.
